errNativeHostMissing.message:
Native helper not installed. Can't copy the image file directly.

Install it (one time, takes seconds):
  cd /Users/bo-bot/fullpage-shot/native-host
  ./install.sh <extensionID>

(Find the extension ID at chrome://extensions on the Fullpage Shot card.)

Without it, the button below will fall back to copying the @path text.

errNativeHostFailed.message:
Native helper call failed: $err$

The button below will fall back to copying @path text.
